company: CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and is led by co-founder and CEO John Tenet. Its Coherent Distributed Networks link many sensors into one radar picture, which the company says can detect threats up to 10 minutes faster than traditional radars.

In November 2025 CHAOS raised a $510 million Series D led by Valor Equity Partners at a $4.5 billion valuation, just four months after a $275 million Series C, bringing total funding above $1 billion.
intelligence.why_it_matters: CHAOS is part of the new wave of venture-backed defense companies, and a read-through for demand for counter-drone systems after recent conflicts.

changed.text: A $510M Series D values it at $4.5B.

takeaways: Two large rounds closed within four months.
Counter-drone detection is a fast-growing defense priority.
Defense contracts can be large but slow to win.
It competes with established primes and startups such as Anduril.
